original_ai_output.title_zh: 南苏丹：特别保护警察小组为性别暴力幸存者寻求正义
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 在南苏丹团结州本提乌的流离失所者营地内，一名遭丈夫咬伤并威胁致盲的女性在临时法庭上获得审理机会。特别保护小组警探尼亚维尔·利亚·迪乌负责调查性暴力和性别暴力案件，为幸存者提供咨询并协助检察官构建案件。该小组由联合国南苏丹特派团法治部门支持。

location.site: 流离失所者营地内的警察局临时法庭
location.raw_text: BENTIU, UNITY STATE - In a makeshift courtroom inside a police station in South Sudan’s largest camp for displaced families

key_facts.fact: 南苏丹团结州本提乌流离失所者营地内，一名女性在临时法庭上就其丈夫施暴案件获得审理机会
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: In a makeshift courtroom inside a police station in South Sudan’s largest camp for displaced families, a young woman stares into her lap.

key_facts.fact: 该女性被丈夫咬伤并威胁致盲，其丈夫被指未工作且未提供经济支持
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: We learn it was inflicted by her husband, who is standing on the other side, behind the defence lawyer. He bit her and threatened to blind her in a fit of rage.

key_facts.fact: 特别保护小组警探尼亚维尔·利亚·迪乌负责调查性暴力和性别暴力案件，并为幸存者提供咨询
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: She is a police investigator with the Special Protection Unit, which handles cases of sexual and gender-based violence.

key_facts.fact: 特别保护小组由联合国南苏丹特派团法治部门支持，以调查案件并改善司法可及性
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The SPU is part of the national police response to gender-based violence, with the Rule of Law Section of the United Nations Mission in South Sudan supporting it to investigate cases and improve access to justice.

uncertainties: 案件最终判决结果尚未确定，法官仅裁定案件有理由并设定后续听证日期
报道为单一来源（联合国南苏丹特派团），尚缺乏独立交叉验证
